caption.text:
Women’s College Hospital’s clinical extern posting closes Nov 20, 2026: BScN, BCLS required, $20.60/hr, up to 7.5 hours per week (as posted). SHN’s clinical nurse extern talent pool (not a specific vacancy) closes Nov 30 ($25.379/hr, BScN year three or final year, BCLS required). Full requirements are on each hospital’s posting.

ontarioexterns.ca is our own independent tracker of Ontario extern postings, checked on hospitals’ own career pages. Not affiliated with any hospital.
